name: La Vídola (Spain)
description: Square flag gyronny of eight pieces of red and white, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of La Vídola (bends of white and blue, and a jug and stars on blue).
history: The arms of La Vídola were published in the Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León on 11 January 1994; the municipal flag was approved on 24 June 1994 and is square, of proportion 1:1, gyronny of red and white of eight alternating pieces.
